title: Odile and the Inheritance
author: Odile Almeida
blurb: Wren Coldharbour, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
